# Paresh Jain: freelance marketing & campaign lead, New Delhi

> Senior marketing and campaign lead for brands, D2C companies, small businesses and agencies, without a full-time hire. 11+ years inside WPP/VML, FCB Kinnect, Schbang and Cheil, on brands including Amazon, Bata, Ford, Honda, MG Motor and Tata Consumer. Works remotely with teams worldwide; based in New Delhi, India. Fixed prices, written scope, free 30-minute review call.

Contact: send an enquiry or book a free 30-minute call at https://www.pareshjain.com/#contact · WhatsApp +91 99998 96986
Prices are in INR and exclude GST and any media or production spend. Teams outside India are quoted in USD.
